answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I gained 4 Block with Shinobu — Grass Ring of Sanctification, dealt 12 total damage to Nibbit with both copies of Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, then played two Coral Guards for 10 more Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered using both energy on Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea, alongside both zero-cost Gorou attacks and the Ring, to prioritize damage while accepting part of the incoming attack.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the substantially higher damage and Hydro application of the offensive line in exchange for reaching 14 Block and fully covering the telegraphed 12 damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. With no incoming attack, or a sufficiently smaller attack, I would have spent the two energy on damage instead of two Coral Guards.
